ADR0015/inline implementation plan define protocol2, same-checkpoint reference transitions, bounded committed views, shared single-use tickets/quotas, metadata hints/reconciliation, optional gateway and browser-safe reconnect client. Ordinary startup/admission remains closed.

Task1 exact-checkpoint worker ref resolution and separate durable reference semantic namespace, cached committed participant projections with48-reader coalescing, byte/count/TTL/in-flight bounds and archive/pin/viewer/outcome keying. Existing trusted raw submit remains internal.

Task2/3 closed protocol2 intents/envelopes/ticket schemas, retained diagnostic1 and new release range1..2; immutable additive0004 permits new match pin2 and adds hashed single-use tickets/shared DB quotas. Participant metadata observer and COMMIT-only NOTIFY hints support reconciliation.

Task4 optional Fastify gateway requires injected AUTH-01 interface and exact origins, bounded first-frame ticket authentication, private session rechecks, refs-only commands, durable receipt mapping and full committed snapshot refresh, hint-independent polling, heartbeat and drain. Ordinary main stays diagnostic-only.

RUN074 used wrong zone field in test; RUN075 corrects kind and reproduces actual raw-ID acceptance before worker fix. RUN083 preserves PostgreSQL42P08 query inference error after0004 test application; explicit actor varchar casts fix it in RUN084 without rewriting SQL.

Selected exact Fastify/WebSocket baseline plus compatible ws8.22.0/@types/ws8.18.2 metadata. RUN085 input archived byte-for-byte under validation/inputs. RUN086 deliberately changes manifest/lock, child0 but receipt source_changed remains failed; RUN087 frozen install and both DB role-health checks pass.
RUN090 reproduces five concurrent actor admissions bypassing the four-slot cap; reserve actor synchronously before asynchronous describe and RUN091 passes all actual gateway negatives.

New browser-owned match-client workspace links contracts with pnpm; wire-only public client has bounded jitter/retry/deadlines, actor-bound pending export/restore, exact request IDs/refs across suspension/hops, strict sequence/pin/viewer checks and separate transient/durable outcomes. No auth cookie, server state or login implementation enters its source.

RUN094 reproduces duplicate pending retransmission on unrelated snapshots, application callback reentrancy invalidating accepted receipts and a replaced-ready promise left pending. RUN095 passes seven client cases after per-connection send tracking, preserved acknowledgement deadlines and internal-state-before-callback ordering.

Link match-client to web with package manager; include its compiled bytes and package metadata in actual release/artifact closure. RUN096 omission red/RUN097 all CI tooling green includes tamper rejection even after refreshing outer hashes. Web dev filesystem explicitly permits only this browser-owned workspace.

RUN098 direct Fastify.close leaves owned resources open; RUN099 exposes test-helper export typo and a pg listener initial-close hang. RUN100 isolates end-before-connect behavior; await each owned connection attempt before ending, including reconnect attempts, and bind cleanup before plugin close. RUN101 passes all11 actual lifecycle/ticket/socket cases.

RUN102 uses actual WebSocket clients against separate OS gateway processes and PostgreSQL to finish a natural reference-only synthetic game. Pausing a client read, waiting for COMMIT, SIGKILLing the owning gateway and reconnecting elsewhere recovers the original old-ref pending intent as one duplicate accepted receipt; journal/outbox stay once.

RUN103 reproduces orphan qualification gateway after controlling parent IPC loss; RUN104 adds parent-loss cleanup and guards disconnect ownership. RUN105 passes all types but fails lint const/test-global rules; RUN106 fixes code without weakening lint.

RUN107 passes all8 Chromium cases, including native HttpOnly cookies, real HTTP/WebSockets, two isolated participants, rotating refs and reconnect to another process. RUN108 passes original bootstrap/role health, real DB/storage/gateway/process-client suite. AUTH-01 remains separate.

Add exact live wire and browser lifecycle contract, optional gateway operation/limits, package API and native validation ledger; update additive0004/protocol1..2/client artifact closure and partial requirement links. Preserve all548 requirement definitions/20 optional/device/status fields and historical evidence.

Independent read-only review finds no important privacy/authority/idempotency defects; two minor callback cleanup findings reproduced in RUN110/RUN113, fixed and all9 client cases pass RUN114. RUN109 documents missing individual schema review; RUN112 detects a wildcard review rendered as a broken link. Expand review paths to actual files; no gate bypass.

Independent static whole-scope review finds no critical/important issues; both minor callback disposal findings are reproduced/fixed/confirmed closed. Review runs no tests or listeners. Current RUN-20261015-002 passes frozen install and whole foundation324 project/406 upstream/2 injection checks with valid timing; no old-source hosted acceptance inferred.

Final executable64bef2e3 passes full frozen foundation324 project/406 upstream/2 injection,35actual DB checks,8foundation+2Lab Chromium, installed license/integrity/advisory222 components, native docs and fresh source-only frozen full suite. Final closure verifies361vendor/59patches,0600private/ignored,2729unique historical blobs,622log digests, original548/33/20 and unchanged prior SQL/engine/container, with no owned listeners/children.

Finalize synthetic PLAY-03 acceptance, exact live/API/operations/contracts/ADR, independent review, feature/backlog/partial requirement links and handoff. Current docs/Git packaging remains checked separately; no ordinary AUTH/card/reward/device/production/remote-host performance or fresh hosted/isolated artifact qualification inferred.
